svg.text: BOUGHT PARTS (estimates unless noted; confirm before order)
Metal detector search head, aperture 300 W x 250 H (12 x 10 in) or the nearest larger, integral control, relay outputs
Stealth / Phantom head + control (used, Sigma Equipment) (confirm aperture,
DETECT and FAULT, 120 V; used, refurbished, with test pieces Fe 1.5 / NFe 2.0 / SS 2.5 and the maker's validation
housing and lug positions before cutting P1-406-104)
Belt: PU 2 mm FDA white, 152 [6 in] wide, 3,035 + splice allowance, open ended, finger-spliced in place (the belt passes
Ropanyl FDA 2 mm 152 wide, on-site finger splice by the supplier or hot-press
through the closed head aperture); 4 x flange bearing UCFL204 stainless, Ø20 bore, 4-bolt
Right-angle hollow-shaft gearmotor 1/8 HP 115 V 1-ph, ≈ 85 rpm, Ø20 mm bore with key, torque arm mount, IP55
Bison 017-656 class or Nord SK 1SI31 + 1-ph motor (confirm bore 20 mm and speed)
Reject pusher: linear actuator 24 V DC, 150 stroke, ≈ 38 mm/s at 100 N, internal limits; 2 relays 24 V DPDT for run and
PA-14-6-35 (150 mm, 35 lb high speed, 24 V option) + G2R-2-SND-24 x 2 with
Controls kit: PC enclosure ≈ 250 x 200 x 130 IP66; CLICK PLC 8 DC in / 6 DC out 24 V; Mean Well LRS-75-24; motor
C0-00DD2-D + C0-08ND3 (confirm I/O) + LRS-75-24 + DC1-09-10-24 class + GCX1131 +
contactor 24 V DC coil 9 A; E-stop 40 mm 2 NC; START green, STOP red, RESET key switch (supervisor), fuse 6 A T,
terminals, M20 glands x 5, cord SJOOW 14/3 3 m + 5-15P
Sensors: 2 x retro-reflective photo eye M18 PNP polarised with reflectors (pack at reject, bin entry), lid reed switch
QS18VP6LP + BRT-32X20AM x 2 + reed switch SR class (confirm)
Stack light 3 colour red / amber / green + buzzer 24 V DC, Ø40, pole mount
Hardware kit: 4 levelling feet M16 Ø80 pad; padlock hasp + 2 padlocks keyed alike (QA holds the key); G10 pad 80 x 70 x
LV.F-80-M16 class + hasp + 2 padlocks + G10 + nylon (confirm)
6 + 4 nylon shoulder bushes; nylon screws M5 x 16 (20); rubber bush for the torque arm
